start: Phone updated to a version with a newer exercise library; the member logged 'Pull Up' (a Hevy title) before

steps.action: Open the app after the update
user_sees: Home opens as usual; the library update runs quietly with no message
must_not: A stuck loading screen
Any exercise or set deleted

user_sees: One 'Pull Up' row, still in the member's own spelling, now with a picture
must_not: Two rows for the same exercise ('Pull Up' and 'Pull-Up')
The member's name for it changed

user_sees: 'How to do it' with numbered steps and the muscles
The same history as before the update
must_not: Weight x reps history now read as a timed exercise
Old sets missing

start: Settings > Back up and restore, a backup file from another phone

user_sees: The restore finishes with the backed-up workouts and routines
must_not: The restored library left without pictures or steps

user_sees: Library exercises with pictures; restored exercises linked to the library
must_not: Duplicate library rows next to the restored ones

start: The member made their own 'Barbell Curl' in the New exercise form with their own muscles

steps.action: Update the app and open it
must_not: A crash on first open

user_sees: Only the member's own 'Barbell Curl', with the muscles they chose
must_not: A second library 'Barbell Curl' added next to theirs
Their muscles overwritten by the library's

start: Library row still named 'Close Grip Bench Press' (the library's older spelling), with logged sets

steps.action: Open the app after the update to library version 2
must_not: The sets of that exercise moved or lost

user_sees: The row now named 'Close-Grip Bench Press', with the same history
must_not: A name the member or Hevy gave changed as well
Two rows that differ only in a dash

start: App launch, member profile exists, stored library version 1, app library version 2

user_sees: Nothing on screen; links, renames and inserts run in one transaction in the app's write queue
must_not: The sync run while another queued write is held (deadlock)
Any row deleted
The version stamped when the transaction failed

user_sees: Stored 2 >= 2, so the sync is skipped
must_not: The sync running on every launch

start: Member restores a cloud copy (copySync) or loads demo data

steps.action: The library is replaced wholesale; the version stamp is set to 0 first
must_not: The old stamp kept, so the new library is never linked

steps.action: Forced sync runs (demo data: dumbbells counted per the library; restore: weight as typed)
user_sees: Rows linked, missing entries inserted, stamp back to 2
must_not: A restored member's dumbbell history re-read as 'kg each'

start: Fresh install, no member profile yet

must_not: A half library inserted before the profile exists

steps.action: Onboarding inserts the whole library and stamps the version (dataActions.ts:381)
must_not: Each entry inserted twice (INSERT OR IGNORE on a fresh id does not stop a twin)

start: Restore replaced the library; the app was killed before the sync ran

user_sees: Stamp was 0, so the sync runs now
must_not: The library left unlinked for good

steps.action: Sync runs a second time later (forced again)
user_sees: Nothing changes: rows already linked stay as they are
must_not: Twin rows from a second insert
Names restyled twice
